dict.string: A program running in one of your Muxbar sessions (for example Claude Code or a shell command) wants to access files in your Desktop folder.
A program running in one of your Muxbar sessions (for example Claude Code or a shell command) wants to access files in your Documents folder.
A program running in one of your Muxbar sessions (for example Claude Code or a shell command) wants to access files in your Downloads folder.
A program running in one of your Muxbar sessions (for example Claude Code or a shell command) touched your Music folder, which holds the Apple Music library.
A program running in one of your Muxbar sessions (for example Claude Code or a shell command) touched your Pictures folder, which holds the Photos library.
A program running in one of your Muxbar sessions (for example Claude Code or a shell command) wants to access files on a removable drive.
A program running in one of your Muxbar sessions (for example Claude Code or a shell command) wants to access files on a network drive.
Muxbar opens, focuses and names Terminal/iTerm2 windows for your sessions. It never reads or types into them except to start or reattach a session.
